entities.name: Project map
entities.meaning: Everything the map knows about one project, kept in one committed file.

store.notes: written in a fixed key order so the same map always produces the same bytes

entities.name: Actor
entities.meaning: A person or program the product recognizes, with what they want from it.

entities.name: Actor link
entities.meaning: One stated tie between two actors, such as one becoming another.

entities.name: Glossary term
entities.meaning: One product word and its plain meaning, with the place in the code it names.

entities.name: Use case
entities.meaning: One goal an actor comes to the product for, with what starts it and what results.

entities.name: Happy path step
entities.meaning: One position in the product's single successful run, naming the use case it plays.

entities.name: Stake
entities.meaning: What one actor comes to a feature to do, in a short phrase.

entities.name: Story anchor
entities.meaning: Where a feature the successful run never reaches sits beside the features it does.

entities.name: Group
entities.meaning: One box grouping other elements: a feature, a subsystem, a data area or a decision area.

entities.name: Evidence
entities.meaning: One citation backing a claim the map makes, with the line to re-read.

entities.name: Interface
entities.meaning: One place the product meets something outside itself.

entities.name: Component
entities.meaning: One module-sized piece of the product, with the files it owns.

entities.name: Dependency
entities.meaning: One outside system or library the product uses.

entities.name: Run command
entities.meaning: One command a person types to work on the product.

entities.name: Way in
entities.meaning: One address, command or tool that starts work inside the product.

entities.name: Record field
entities.meaning: One attribute of a saved record, with its type and its key markers.

entities.name: Record relation
entities.meaning: One typed link from a saved record to another, with how many sit at each end.

entities.name: Channel
entities.meaning: One queue or topic the product sends messages on, with who puts and who takes.

entities.name: State change
entities.meaning: One move from one state to another, with the trigger that causes the move.

entities.name: Lifecycle
entities.meaning: The states a record or a component moves through, and the moves between them.

entities.name: Store
entities.meaning: Where a record physically lives: which store, which compartment, and how it sits there.

entities.name: Record
entities.meaning: One named thing the product works with, and what the product keeps of it.

entities.name: Skipped type
entities.meaning: A named type in the product left out of the record model on purpose.

entities.name: Flow step
entities.meaning: One step of a use case, saying who acts on what, and which way data moves.

entities.name: Flow
entities.meaning: The numbered steps of one use case, in the order they happen.

entities.name: Shared sub-flow
entities.meaning: A run of steps several use cases share, written once.

entities.name: Edge
entities.meaning: One relation between two boxes on the map, with the line where it happens.

relations.how: each end names a component, a dependency or a record by its id, so no single field points at one kind

entities.name: Environment tag
entities.meaning: One environment a deployment unit runs in, with the manifest line placing it.

entities.name: Deployment unit
entities.meaning: One process or container the product ships as, and what it runs on.

entities.name: Signal
entities.meaning: One thing the product reports about itself, where it goes and who watches.

entities.name: Security surface
entities.meaning: One guarded place, who may reach it, and what is at stake. Kept only for older maps.

store.notes: older maps only; a new map states the same fact as a business rule marked as an access decision

entities.name: Setting
entities.meaning: One setting the product reads, what it is for, and its default.

entities.name: Test row
entities.meaning: How well one part of the product is tested, and what the gap is.

relations.how: the assessed list holds ids of any kind, so no single field points at one kind

entities.name: Rule site
entities.meaning: One line where a business rule is actually enforced.

entities.name: Business rule
entities.meaning: One decision the product makes, in product words, with every place it is enforced.

entities.name: Extra section
entities.meaning: One authored section of notes kept with the map, under its own heading.

entities.name: Grounding record
entities.meaning: How much of the map's claim surface skeptics challenged, and how the votes fell.

entities.name: Use case reach
entities.meaning: The interfaces one use case reaches, worked out from its steps.

store.container: worked out from the flows on demand

entities.name: Graph
entities.meaning: Everything the viewer needs to draw one map, built fresh on every request.

store.container: built for the browser on request

relations.how: built in full from the whole map each time the viewer asks, and never saved

entities.name: Graph box
entities.meaning: One thing drawn on a view, with its name, its code link and its tags.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Graph arrow
entities.meaning: One arrow drawn between two boxes, with its label and how many sit at each end.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Graph walk step
entities.meaning: One position in the successful run as the viewer receives it.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Test target
entities.meaning: One element a test row assesses, resolved to a name the reader sees.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Test row view
entities.meaning: One coverage row as the viewer receives it, with its assessed elements resolved.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Extra section view
entities.meaning: One authored section as the viewer receives it, with the elements it names resolved.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Change impact report
entities.meaning: What a code change does to the map, read back from the written report.

store.container: read back from the written report

entities.name: Change impact entry
entities.meaning: One element the change touched, and what happened to it.

store.container: read back from the written report

entities.name: Viewer flow
entities.meaning: One use case's steps as the viewer receives them.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: Viewer flow step
entities.meaning: One step as the viewer receives it, with each end marked as an element or a person.

store.container: built for the browser on request

entities.name: File walk result
entities.meaning: The source files a scan counted, and what it skipped and why.

entities.name: Code symbol
entities.meaning: One class or function found in the source, with where it is defined.

store.notes: copied into the scan's own output file as plain rows, never kept as this shape

entities.name: Import reference
entities.meaning: One import line found in the source, naming what it pulls in.

store.notes: copied into the scan's own output file as plain rows, never kept as this shape

entities.name: Directory expectation
entities.meaning: How many components one folder should hold, given its size.

entities.name: Notes heading spec
entities.meaning: One recognized notes heading, and how the lines under it are read.

store.container: a fixed list written in the source

entities.name: Map profile
entities.meaning: The measurable quality signals of one built map, kept so two maps can be compared.

store.notes: written beside the map being scored, in a folder git never tracks

relations.how: measured from one built map at score time, and the map itself carries no pointer back

entities.name: Reconcile file
entities.meaning: The decisions a build records so the next rebuild does not lose them.

store.notes: committed beside the map, and replayed on every rebuild

entities.name: Set directive
entities.meaning: An instruction filling in one field on the elements it names.

entities.name: Drop-edge directive
entities.meaning: An instruction removing one relation between two boxes.

relations.how: names the relation by its two ends and its word, because a relation carries no id of its own

entities.name: Keep-edge directive
entities.meaning: An instruction saying which line survives when one relation is declared twice.

relations.how: names the relation by its two ends and its word, because a relation carries no id of its own

entities.name: Anchor directive
entities.meaning: A corrected code link, kept so every rebuild re-applies the correction.

entities.name: Drop-relation directive
entities.meaning: An instruction removing one link declared on a record.

relations.how: names the record card, the word and the far record, because a link carries no id of its own

entities.name: Element check
entities.meaning: One element beside what the skeptics did to the claims it makes.

store.container: worked out again whenever it is asked for

relations.how: worked out again from the pinned claim list and the saved votes, so it can never drift from them

entities.name: Surviving refutation
entities.meaning: A claim skeptics refuted that the shipped map still makes, word for word.

store.container: worked out again whenever it is asked for

relations.how: found by matching the saved votes against the shipped map, which stores no pointer back

entities.name: Verdict lint result
entities.meaning: What a shape check of the skeptics' saved votes found.

entities.name: Fragment load
entities.meaning: What reading a set of harvest files produced, including the files that failed.

entities.name: Store mode
entities.meaning: The closed list of ways a record can relate to the place that holds it.

store.container: a fixed list of seven words

entities.name: Interface kind
entities.meaning: The closed list of words saying what kind of thing an interface is.

store.container: a fixed list of eleven words
store.notes: new words may be minted for one project, so the list is a seed rather than a wall

entities.name: Way-in kind
entities.meaning: The closed list of words saying by what mechanism a way in is reached.

store.container: a fixed list of eleven words
store.notes: new words may be minted for one project, so the list is a seed rather than a wall

entities.name: Step direction
entities.meaning: The three words saying which way data moves in one step.

store.container: a fixed list of three words

non_entity_types.name: ModelError
non_entity_types.why: An error raised when a map file has the wrong shape. It carries no product data.

non_entity_types.name: WrongMapError
non_entity_types.why: An error raised when the tool is pointed at its own map instead of the project's. Not product data.

non_entity_types.name: ReconcileError
non_entity_types.why: An error raised when a recorded decision cannot be applied. It carries no product data.

non_entity_types.name: IgnoreSpec
non_entity_types.why: The patterns saying which files a scan skips. Build input, not something the map keeps.

non_entity_types.name: Extents
non_entity_types.why: A shorthand name for plain lists of line ranges. There is no named record behind it.
